page.viewerHelp: Scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to pan and double-click to go back to the starting view. With the keyboard: arrow keys, plus, minus and zero.
page.viewerHelpSpectrum: A click or a tap on the image shows the spectrum and the light curve of that point.

hint.difference: A minus B: the current epoch minus the reference.
hint.redcyan: A in red and B in cyan. What did not change stays grey.
hint.sum: Average of the epochs with an image: {{n}}.
hint.hold: A is shown. While the button or the space bar is held down, B is shown.
hint.journey: 2MASS, WISE and the SPHEREx epochs, in date order. Step through them with the control below.

issue.missing-current: The current epoch has no image in this band.
issue.missing-reference: Another epoch with an image is needed to compare.

comparison.provisional: One of the compared epochs is provisional: some of its exposures are still missing.

load.downloadFailed: Images that could not be downloaded: {{n}}.

stage.building: New field: it is being built from IRSA images. The first image arrives in about a minute and the full field takes a few minutes.
stage.empty: This epoch has no data in {{band}}.
stage.pending: The image of this epoch has not arrived yet.
stage.previewNote: This is not a SPHEREx image.

summary.trail: Trail with its positions in the earlier epochs: {{n}}.
summary.orientation: North is up and east is to the left.

flags.hint: The hatch covers the pixels that the processing discards.
flags.none: This image has no flagged pixels.
flags.idle: Flags are shown when a SPHEREx image is on screen.
flags.error: The flags could not be loaded.

saturated_source.one: There is a saturated source at {{ra}} {{dec}}: its centre has no valid measurement.
saturated_source.other: There are {{n}} saturated sources in the field: their centres have no valid measurement.

quality.low_coverage: Less than {{limit}} of the image has data: {{planes}}.

cutouts_failed.other: {{n}} cutouts are missing after all the retries: {{planes}}.

quality.stale_exposure_list: The exposure list is a copy saved on {{date}}: the data archive did not respond.
quality.full_download: Whole files were downloaded because the download could not be cut short.
